session_read: Pre-market bounce off yesterday's FOMC-eve selloff -- Asia up across the board overnight, VIX down to 16.98, gate flips from ESCALATING to STABILIZING. Signals and thesis both confirm this is technical washout, not a fundamental reversal: no verdicts changed. The three real drivers from Monday's drop (GLW's ATM, GEV's Sell-rating tension, STM's guide miss) are untouched. FOMC decision lands today at 14:00 ET.
